english.title: Company / officer fail to deliver information to the registrar during a period of election
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were

(A)_[a company which]_
(B)_[an officer, namely **(..SPECIFY OFFICER..) of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..) and who was in default in that the company]_

failed, during the period when an election under section 790X of the Companies Act 2006 was in force, to deliver to the registrar information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..), that the company would during that period have been obliged under Chapter 3 of the Act to enter in its PSC register, had the election not been in force, as soon as reasonably practicable after the company became aware of it and, in any event, no later than the time by which the company would have been required to enter the information in its PSC register
english.legislation: Contrary to section 790ZA of the Companies Act 2006.

english.notes:
(i) Section 790ZA(3) states: The information must be delivered as soon as reasonably practicable after the company becomes aware of it and, in any event, no later than the time by which the company would have been required to enter the information in its PSC register.
(ii) Civil financial penalties may be issued by the registrar for this offence being a ‘relevant offence’ as defined by section 1132A of the Companies Act 2006. No criminal proceedings may be commenced against a person in respect of conduct amounting to an offence if the person has already been given a financial penalty by the registrar. Further, no financial penalty may be imposed on a person in relation to conduct amounting to an offence if proceedings in respect of that offence are ongoing or the person has been convicted.
